decisions.rationale: Lead Gengar+Lucario: both outspeed the opponent's Trick Room setters (Farigiraf/Chandelure) and hit Farigiraf super effectively (Ghost/Fighting), removing Armor Tail that would otherwise block all our priority moves (Protect/Wide Guard). Empoleon+Bastiodon form the bulky Steel backline with Wide Guard and Fairy/resistances.
decisions.notebook: Opponent carries Farigiraf (Armor Tail): while active it blocks ALL our priority moves—Protect, Wide Guard, Fake Out, Prankster screens—and sets Trick Room. Chandelure also Trick Room. Camerupt/Chandelure are spread Fire/Ground special threats (Eruption/Heat Wave/Earth Power). Mawile-Mega Huge Power physical (Play Rough/Sucker Punch). Liepard Prankster Fake Out/Encore/Taunt; Heliolisk Choice Scarf Electric/Normal. Plan: lead Gengar+Lucario (outspeed setters; Ghost/Fighting hit Farigiraf SE) to strip Armor Tail/Trick Room, then bring Empoleon+Bastiodon Steel core for Wide Guard and Fairy/resistances. Grimmsnarl is dead weight vs Farigiraf (all its moves are priority, blocked); Arcanine Intimidate dropped for the core. Mega Gengar Shadow Tag traps switchless foes.

decisions.rationale: Lead Farigiraf + Camerupt establishes the preferred Trick Room/Mega Camerupt line into Gengar and the Steel core. Mawile is the key Grimmsnarl answer under Room, while Scarf Heliolisk gives important Empoleon pressure and a fast mode if Trick Room is unfavorable.
decisions.notebook: Preferred baseline into this roster: Farigiraf + Camerupt lead, with Mega Camerupt favored versus Mega Gengar and Steel-heavy selections. Mental Herb lets Farigiraf force Trick Room through conventional Taunt; Armor Tail blocks opposing priority directed at allies. Preserve Mawile for Grimmsnarl and physical cleanup under Trick Room. Heliolisk provides fast Empoleon pressure outside Room. Opponent roster: Mega Gengar, Empoleon, Grimmsnarl, Bastiodon, Arcanine, Lucario.

decisions.rationale: Focus Farigiraf: it's the Trick Room setter and our only Ghost-immune target (Shadow Ball 0x), so Gengar's Sludge Bomb + Lucario's Close Combat combine for 88-163% (possible OHKO). Mega Gengar is strictly better here (Speed 200, SpA 222, Shadow Tag) and traps Farigiraf so it can't switch out. Both mons outspeed, hitting before Camerupt's 2x-SE Earth Power.
decisions.notebook: Opponent threats: Farigiraf (Armor Tail, Sassy) sets Trick Room; CORRECTION: Armor Tail only blocks priority moves targeting the opponent's side, so our Protect/Wide Guard (target our side) work fine while it's active—its real disruption is Trick Room. Chandelure also Trick Room. Camerupt/Chandelure are spread Fire/Ground special threats (Eruption/Heat Wave/Earth Power); Camerupt Earth Power is 2x SE on Gengar (Poison) and Lucario (Steel). Mawile-Mega Huge Power physical. Liepard Prankster Fake Out/Encore/Taunt; Heliolisk Choice Scarf Electric/Normal. Plan: lead Gengar+Lucario (outspeed setters) to remove Farigiraf/Trick Room, then Empoleon+Bastiodon Steel core (Wide Guard + resistances). Mega Gengar is strictly superior with our spread (Speed 200, SpA 222, Shadow Tag) — Mega turn 1 to trap switchless foes. Farigiraf immune to Ghost (Shadow Ball 0x); Gengar uses Sludge Bomb (neutral). Lucario Close Combat is neutral (1x) on Farigiraf (Fighting 2x vs Normal, 0.5x vs Psychic) but best BP option; combined Close Combat+Sludge Bomb = 88-163% (possible OHKO, not guaranteed).

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Camerupt)
decisions.rationale: Mega Camerupt Protect maximizes the chance that Farigiraf establishes Trick Room safely; neither revealed foe has Taunt, and Armor Tail already denies Bullet Punch. Mega Camerupt then becomes the slowest relevant attacker and can pressure both foes with full-HP Eruption under Room.
decisions.notebook: Game-plan baseline: lead Farigiraf + Camerupt into this roster. Mega Camerupt is preferred versus Mega Gengar and Steel-heavy compositions; under Trick Room its 36 Speed lets it move before the revealed opposing core. Full-HP Mega Camerupt Eruption is a guaranteed OHKO on Lucario in the engine’s legal range and does substantial neutral damage to Mega Gengar. Farigiraf’s Mental Herb covers conventional Taunt and Armor Tail blocks priority aimed at allies. Preserve Mawile for physical Trick Room cleanup and Grimmsnarl; preserve Scarf Heliolisk for fast Empoleon pressure outside Trick Room. Opponent possible back line from open sheet: Empoleon, Grimmsnarl, Bastiodon, Arcanine; only two accompany revealed Gengar/Lucario.

decisions.rationale: Switch Mawile to gain Intimidate on Lucario and preserve Choice Scarf Heliolisk for Empoleon. Mawile also resists Gengar’s Sludge Bomb and Lucario’s Steel attacks, making it the sturdier immediate replacement.
decisions.notebook: Game-plan: Mega Camerupt remains the sole Mega Evolution this game. Preserve Scarf Heliolisk for fast pressure into Empoleon and other Water types. Mawile is the preferred physical pivot versus Lucario due to Intimidate and its Steel typing; avoid treating Mawile as a Mega option after Camerupt has evolved. Opponent’s two unrevealed back Pokémon are drawn from Empoleon, Grimmsnarl, Bastiodon, and Arcanine.

decisions.rationale: Gengar Protects to blank Mawile's priority Sucker Punch (OHKOs Gengar if it Mega Evolves) and Camerupt's Earth Power. Lucario switches to Empoleon: Fire and Dark are neutral on Empoleon (no OHKO), so both mons survive. Neither can safely attack (Gengar draws Sucker Punch, Lucario draws Fire; Close Combat is neutral on both foes, ≤83%, no KO). This protects both while bringing in my Fire-neutral wall; Empoleon's Surf is 2x SE on Camerupt for next-turn pressure.
decisions.notebook: Opponent threats (game 1): Farigiraf fainted (Armor Tail only blocks foe-side priority; our Protect/Wide Guard fine). Camerupt-Mega Fire/Ground special: Earth Power 2x SE on Gengar+Lucario BUT also 2x SE on ally Mawile, so opponent avoids it; Heat Wave/Eruption 2x SE on Lucario (OHKO), neutral on Gengar. Mawile (Intimidate used): Mega->Huge Power; Sucker Punch priority 2x SE OHKO on Gengar if Mega (Gengar must Protect); Play Rough 0.5x on Gengar; Knock Off 2x SE on Gengar. 4th benched unknown (Chandelure/Liepard/Heliolisk). CORRECTIONS: Lucario Close Combat is NEUTRAL on Mawile (Fighting 2x Steel x0.5x Fairy=1x) and NEUTRAL on Camerupt-Mega (Fighting not SE vs Fire/Ground) - cannot OHKO either. Gengar Shadow Ball neutral on both; Sludge Bomb 0x on Mawile (Steel immune), 0.5x on Camerupt. Plan: cannot safely attack (Gengar attracts Sucker Punch, Lucario attracts Fire). Gengar Protect + switch Lucario->Empoleon (Fire/Dark neutral, safe) to wall Camerupt; then Empoleon Surf 2x SE Camerupt + later Bastiodon Wide Guard. Gengar Speed 200 outspeeds all (Liepard max 173, Heliolisk 177, Chandelure 127).

decisions.rationale: Earth Power guarantees the Mega Gengar KO if it does not Protect. Play Rough exploits Lucario’s -1 Defense and current 90% HP for a possible second KO; splitting targets also means either single Protect still leaves strong pressure on the other foe.
decisions.notebook: Game-plan: Mega Camerupt is the sole Mega Evolution this game; do not treat Mawile as a Mega option. Preserve Choice Scarf Heliolisk for fast pressure into Empoleon and other Water types. Mawile is the preferred physical pivot versus Lucario due to Intimidate and Steel typing. Opponent unrevealed back Pokémon are two of Empoleon, Grimmsnarl, Bastiodon, and Arcanine. Revealed opposing sets: Mega Gengar has Shadow Ball, Sludge Bomb, Nasty Plot, Protect; Life Orb Adamant Lucario has Close Combat, Meteor Mash, Bullet Punch, Protect. Mega Camerupt Earth Power is a guaranteed OHKO on either Mega Gengar or Lucario at shown health absent Protect.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Gengar must Protect to survive Mawile's Sucker Punch (priority 2x SE OHKO); Protect also blocks ally Surf. Empoleon Surf hits Camerupt 4x SE (and Mawile neutral) while Gengar is shielded. Best damage + safety.
decisions.notebook: Opponent threats (game 1): Farigiraf fainted. Camerupt-Mega Fire/Ground special: Earth Power 2x SE on Gengar+Empoleon; Heat Wave/Eruption 2x SE on Lucario. Mawile (Intimidate used): Mega->Huge Power; Sucker Punch priority 2x SE OHKO on Gengar; Play Rough 0.5x on Gengar/Empoleon; Knock Off 2x SE on Gengar. 4th benched unknown (Chandelure/Liepard/Heliolisk). Lucario Close Combat NEUTRAL on Mawile and Camerupt. Gengar Speed 200 outspeeds all. Plan: Gengar Protect vs Mawile, Empoleon Surf 4x SE Camerupt; later Bastiodon Wide Guard.

decisions.rationale: Sucker Punch is the only immediate pressure before Mega Gengar can move, while Protect preserves Camerupt from Empoleon’s potentially OHKOing Surf and Gengar’s Shadow Ball. This keeps Camerupt positioned to threaten both foes next turn.
decisions.notebook: Game-plan: Mega Camerupt is the sole Mega Evolution this game; do not treat Mawile as a Mega option. Preserve Choice Scarf Heliolisk for fast pressure into Empoleon and other Water types. Mawile is the preferred physical pivot versus Lucario due to Intimidate and Steel typing. Revealed opposing sets: Mega Gengar has Shadow Ball, Sludge Bomb, Nasty Plot, Protect; Life Orb Adamant Lucario has Close Combat, Meteor Mash, Bullet Punch, Protect; Empoleon has Surf, Flash Cannon, Stealth Rock, Protect. Mega Camerupt Earth Power is a guaranteed OHKO on Mega Gengar or Lucario at shown health absent Protect. Mega Gengar’s Protect was used consecutively across turns 2-3 if it chooses it now, reducing its success chance. Mawile’s non-Mega Sucker Punch is not a guaranteed OHKO on Mega Gengar.

decisions.rationale: Mawile Sucker Punch (even non-Mega high-Atk, certainly Mega Huge Power) is a guaranteed KO on Gengar at 64%, and it outprioritizes Gengar's attacks, so Gengar must Protect. Empoleon Surf is 4x SE on Camerupt (possible OHKO, chips Mawile too) and is blocked on the ally by Gengar's Protect. Safe, high-value pressure.
decisions.notebook: Opponent threats (game 1): Farigiraf fainted. Camerupt-Mega Fire/Ground special: Earth Power 2x SE on Gengar+Empoleon; Heat Wave/Eruption 2x SE on Lucario. Mawile (Intimidate used) Brave: Mega->Huge Power; Sucker Punch priority 2x SE guaranteed KO on Gengar (never attack into it); Play Rough 0.5x on Gengar/Empoleon; Knock Off 2x SE on Gengar. 4th benched unknown (Chandelure/Liepard/Heliolisk; only 1 real). Gengar Speed 200 outspeeds all non-priority. Plan: Gengar Protect vs Mawile, Empoleon Surf 4x SE Camerupt; later Bastiodon Wide Guard vs spread. Gengar Shadow Ball OHKOs Mawile (51%) once safe.

decisions.rationale: Preserve Camerupt from Empoleon’s 4x-effective Surf by bringing in Dry Skin Heliolisk. Sucker Punch acts before Mega Gengar’s normal-priority attacks and can KO from 64%; if Gengar uses Nasty Plot instead, Heliolisk’s Scarf Speed provides immediate follow-up pressure next turn.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 revealed sets: Mega Gengar—Shadow Ball, Sludge Bomb, Nasty Plot, Protect; Empoleon—Surf, Flash Cannon, Stealth Rock, Protect; Lucario—Close Combat, Meteor Mash, Bullet Punch, Protect, Life Orb, Adamant; Mawile revealed Intimidate. Mega Camerupt is already the chosen Mega. Preserve Choice Scarf Dry Skin Heliolisk as the primary Empoleon/Water answer; it outruns Mega Gengar while scarfed. Mega Camerupt Earth Power cleanly threatens Mega Gengar and Lucario when it can safely move. Mega Gengar has demonstrated consecutive Protect attempts; account for reduced repeated-Protect odds. Mawile’s non-Mega Sucker Punch can pressure but is not a guaranteed Mega Gengar KO from moderate health.

decisions.rationale: Sucker Punch pressures any attacking Gengar before it can act, while Earth Power targets Empoleon to punish Gengar’s likely Protect and remove the Surf threat.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 revealed sets: Mega Gengar—Shadow Ball, Sludge Bomb, Nasty Plot, Protect; Empoleon—Surf, Flash Cannon, Stealth Rock, Protect; Lucario—Close Combat, Meteor Mash, Bullet Punch, Protect, Life Orb, Adamant; Mawile revealed Intimidate. Preserve Choice Scarf Dry Skin Heliolisk as the primary Empoleon/Water answer; it outruns Mega Gengar while scarfed. Mega Camerupt Earth Power cleanly threatens Mega Gengar and Lucario when it can safely move. Mega Gengar has demonstrated consecutive Protect attempts; account for reduced repeated-Protect odds.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Switch Gengar to Lucario to dodge Mawile's priority Sucker Punch (could KO 64% Gengar if it Mega Evolves into Huge Power). Lucario is neutral/0.5x to all of both foes' moves and hits Heliolisk 2x SE with Close Combat. Empoleon's Flash Cannon alone guarantees the 5% Mawile KO. Empoleon survives Heliolisk's Thunderbolt (max 67% < 98% HP). Risk-free: removes Mawile, preserves Gengar, leaves Lucario+Empoleon+Bastiodon vs lone Heliolisk.
decisions.notebook: Opp game1 team (4 brought): Farigiraf(ArmorTail/MentalHerb/Sassy; fnt), Camerupt-Mega(Quiet; fnt), Mawile(Brave/Intimidate/Mawilite; PlayRough/SuckerPunch/KnockOff/Protect), Heliolisk(Timid/ChoiceScarf/DrySkin; Thunderbolt/VoltSwitch/GrassKnot/HyperVoice). Chandelure(Quiet/Chandelurite) & Liepard(Timid/FocusSash/Prankster) NOT brought g1 — may appear later. Mawile SuckerPunch prio+1 2xSE on Gengar: never expose Gengar to it. Gengar ShadowBall immune to Heliolisk(Normal); SludgeBomb neutral only. Lucario CloseCombat 2xSE Heliolisk; Bastiodon BodyPress 2xSE Heliolisk. Heliolisk Scarf outspeeds all (eff 211-265); Thunderbolt 2xSE Empoleon (~67% max). Plan: vs Heliolisk use Lucario/Bastiodon; keep Gengar away from Mawile prio; if Chandelure/Liepard appear, watch Mega Infiltrator SpA175 and Prankster FakeOut/Taunt.

decisions.rationale: Double-target Mega Gengar: Sucker Punch has priority and, if Gengar attacks, its damage plus Scarf Thunderbolt guarantees the KO from 64%. A fourth consecutive Protect has sharply reduced success; Empoleon’s Surf is absorbed by Dry Skin, so preserving Heliolisk against the likely remaining Empoleon is favored.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 reveals: Mega Gengar has Shadow Ball, Sludge Bomb, Nasty Plot, Protect; Empoleon has Surf, Flash Cannon, Stealth Rock, Protect with Leftovers/Torrent; Lucario is Adamant Life Orb with Close Combat, Meteor Mash, Bullet Punch, Protect. Opponent’s fourth is one of Grimmsnarl, Bastiodon, or Arcanine. Mega Gengar has successfully used three consecutive Protects, so further consecutive attempts are heavily reduced. Heliolisk is Timid Choice Scarf Dry Skin and outspeeds Mega Gengar; Dry Skin absorbs Water moves, making it the key Empoleon answer. Mega Camerupt was chosen as this game’s Mega, so Mawile remains non-Mega. Mawile’s unboosted Sucker Punch into Mega Gengar from this game’s revealed build is only a possible, not guaranteed, KO at roughly two-thirds health.

decisions.rationale: Heliolisk (Scarf, eff 211-265) outspeeds and KOs Lucario (17%) with Thunderbolt before Close Combat fires. Switch Lucario to Bastiodon; Heliolisk (Choice-locked Thunderbolt) cannot OHKO Empoleon (42-61%) or Bastiodon (28-51%). Empoleon Surf + Bastiodon Body Press (2xSE, Def-based) combine for 80-163% of Heliolisk HP, guaranteeing the OHKO on the last foe and winning game 1.
decisions.notebook: Opp game1 team (4 brought): Farigiraf(ArmorTail/MentalHerb/Sassy; fnt), Camerupt-Mega(Quiet; fnt), Mawile(Brave/Intimidate/Mawilite; fnt), Heliolisk(Timid/ChoiceScarf/DrySkin; Thunderbolt/VoltSwitch/GrassKnot/HyperVoice; fnt). Chandelure(Quiet/Chandelurite; ShadowBall/HeatWave/Imprison/TrickRoom) & Liepard(Timid/FocusSash/Prankster; Taunt/Encore/Snarl/FakeOut) NOT brought g1 - may appear g2/g3. Heliolisk Scarf outspeeds all; Thunderbolt 2xSE Empoleon, neutral on Lucario. Plan vs Heliolisk: switch Lucario out (dies to faster Thunderbolt at low HP) and KO with Bastiodon BodyPress (2xSE, Def-based) + Empoleon Surf; never let low-HP Lucario CloseCombat into a faster Thunderbolt user. Mawile SuckerPunch prio+1 2xSE on Gengar: never expose Gengar to it. If Chandelure/Liepard appear, watch Mega Infiltrator SpA175 and Prankster FakeOut/Taunt/Encore.

decisions.rationale: Heliolisk’s Choice Scarf lets it eliminate the 17% Lucario before Close Combat can remove it. Empoleon’s Surf is absorbed by Dry Skin, so Lucario is the immediate threat and must be removed first.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Mega Gengar set is Shadow Ball / Sludge Bomb / Nasty Plot / Protect, Timid Gengarite. Empoleon is Calm Leftovers Torrent with Surf / Flash Cannon / Stealth Rock / Protect. Lucario is Adamant Life Orb Inner Focus with Close Combat / Meteor Mash / Bullet Punch / Protect. Opponent’s fourth is Grimmsnarl, Bastiodon, or Arcanine. Mega Gengar successfully used three consecutive Protects; further consecutive Protect is heavily reduced. Heliolisk is Timid Choice Scarf Dry Skin; it outspeeds Mega Gengar and absorbs Water attacks, making it the Empoleon answer. Mega Camerupt was selected in game 1, leaving Mawile un-Mega. Non-Mega Mawile Sucker Punch versus Mega Gengar around two-thirds HP was only a possible, not guaranteed KO.

decisions.rationale: Heliolisk is the opponent's last Pokémon, Choice-locked into Thunderbolt and unable to switch. DrySkin makes Surf heal it, so Bastiodon's 2x-SE Body Press is our KO move. A critical Thunderbolt can OHKO Empoleon (up to ~100%), so Empoleon Protects to erase that risk; Bastiodon is safe vs any Thunderbolt (even crit 25-47% < 67% HP). Body Press alone should KO (Heliolisk Timid/low-HP); if not, repeat next turn safely since Heliolisk stays locked.
decisions.notebook: Opp game1 brought: Farigiraf(ArmorTail/MentalHerb/Sassy), Camerupt-Mega(Quiet), Mawile(Brave/Intimidate/Mawilite), Heliolisk(Timid/ChoiceScarf/DrySkin; Thunderbolt/VoltSwitch/GrassKnot/HyperVoice). Chandelure(Quiet/Chandelurite; ShadowBall/HeatWave/Imprison/TrickRoom) & Liepard(Timid/FocusSash/Prankster; Taunt/Encore/Snarl/FakeOut) NOT brought g1 - may appear g2/g3. Heliolisk Scarf outspeeds all; Thunderbolt 2xSE Empoleon (crit can OHKO Empoleon), neutral on Bastiodon/Lucario. DrySkin absorbs Water (Surf heals it). Plan vs Heliolisk: Bastiodon Body Press (2xSE, Def-based) is the KO move; never Surf into DrySkin; Empoleon Protect to dodge crit-OHKO. If not KO'd, repeat next turn (Heliolisk locked, can't switch). General: Mawile SuckerPunch prio+1 2xSE on Gengar: never expose Gengar. If Chandelure/Liepard appear, watch Mega Infiltrator SpA175 and Prankster FakeOut/Taunt/Encore.

decisions.rationale: Bastiodon’s Body Press is a guaranteed KO on Heliolisk, so no line survives optimal play. Thunderbolt into Empoleon is the only target with meaningful upside: it deals far more damage and retains a critical-hit KO possibility, unlike hitting Bastiodon.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 revealed: Mega Gengar is Timid Gengarite, Shadow Ball / Sludge Bomb / Nasty Plot / Protect; it successfully used three consecutive Protects. Empoleon is Calm Leftovers Torrent, Surf / Flash Cannon / Stealth Rock / Protect. Lucario is Adamant Life Orb Inner Focus, Close Combat / Meteor Mash / Bullet Punch / Protect. Heliolisk is Timid Choice Scarf Dry Skin and outspeeds Mega Gengar; it is immune to Surf and is the main Empoleon answer. Mega Camerupt was selected, leaving Mawile non-Mega. Bastiodon is Calm Sturdy with Wide Guard / Protect / Stealth Rock / Body Press; Body Press cleanly OHKOs full Heliolisk, while Heliolisk Thunderbolt does only 24-42% to Bastiodon and 51-92% to Empoleon. Opponent’s fourth is Grimmsnarl, Bastiodon, or Arcanine.

reflections.summary: Lost because Farigiraf was KOed before establishing Trick Room, leaving Mega Camerupt without its speed support; repeated Sucker Punches into Gengar Protect also gave the opponent free turns to preserve Gengar and wear down the remaining attackers. The preview plan of Mega Camerupt plus a late Heliolisk did not match Gengar/Empoleon/Bastiodon well.
reflections.adjustment: For game 2, keep Heliolisk in the four but make Mawile the Mega instead of Camerupt and lead more proactively with Heliolisk pressure rather than relying on a fragile Farigiraf Trick Room setup; do not repeatedly click Sucker Punch while Gengar can Protect.
reflections.notebook: Game 1 opponent brought Mega Gengar, Empoleon, Lucario, and Bastiodon. Mega Gengar is Timid with Shadow Ball/Sludge Bomb/Nasty Plot/Protect and was willing to chain Protect. Empoleon is Calm Leftovers Torrent with Surf/Flash Cannon/Stealth Rock/Protect. Lucario is Adamant Life Orb Inner Focus with Close Combat/Meteor Mash/Bullet Punch/Protect. Bastiodon is Calm Sturdy with Wide Guard/Protect/Stealth Rock/Body Press; it survived Heliolisk Thunderbolt comfortably and Body Press OHKOed Heliolisk. Future plan: prioritize Heliolisk pressure versus Empoleon, avoid committing to Camerupt Mega/Trick Room as the primary plan, and consider Mega Mawile instead.
